note: Provider-agnostic known fusions. op_set uses the catalog op_tag_vocab; matching = region op-set subset of strategy op_set + dtype-compat. Priors ADD candidates, never prune. confidence: verified|known|hypothesis.

strategies.description: residual-add + RMSNorm + fp8 (group) quant folded into one kernel
strategies.typical_seam: post-attn/post-ffn residual add -> input RMSNorm -> next-op fp8 group quant

strategies.description: TP all-reduce fused with the following residual-add + RMSNorm
strategies.typical_seam: TP all-reduce write -> residual add -> RMSNorm (flag --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion)

strategies.description: all-reduce + add + RMSNorm + per-group fp8 quant in one collective kernel
strategies.typical_seam: TP all-reduce -> residual RMSNorm -> FFN/expert-input fp8 quant
strategies.notes: banner can print while the arg is False; fused collective silently falls back above a 64MiB size guard (prefill exceeds).

strategies.description: Q/K RMSNorm + fp8 group quant fused
strategies.typical_seam: attention q/k RMSNorm -> fp8 group quant before the score GEMM

strategies.description: wide MLA head-prep: qk-norm + RoPE + paged KV-cache write + fp8 quant in ONE kernel
strategies.typical_seam: MLA head-prep (q/k norm -> RoPE -> concat -> fp8 cast -> paged cache write)
strategies.notes: SPANS a donor boundary (norm is pre-attention, cache-write is post) — the region model proposes narrower sub-fusions; this wide kernel needs a cross-region proposal.

strategies.description: fold the K fp8 quantization into the paged KV-cache write
strategies.typical_seam: decode MLA: separate K fp8 quant + set_mla_kv_buffer write -> one triton kernel
strategies.notes: sglang path gated on `_is_hip and use_nsa and dtype==fp8` (off for non-NSA DSR1); backend-dependent (aiter backend writes via kn_entry_2c). Reported ~342us/1.34% decode on another config.

strategies.typical_seam: FFN gate/up-GEMM output -> SiLU*Mul -> fp8 group quant before down-GEMM
strategies.notes: prefill single-shot may be SLOWER than the split (measured 0.48x at M=7389) — gate on 单侧; decode fine.

strategies.description: fold activation + fp8 quant INTO the down/expert GEMM (deep-gemm style)
strategies.typical_seam: FFN/expert: act -> quant -> down-GEMM as one deep-gemm call
strategies.notes: the wide cross-donor version of activation_quant; the region model (donor-bounded) will not propose it alone.

strategies.description: fold the input fp8 (per-token-group) quant into the GEMM prologue
strategies.typical_seam: o_proj / expert-input: fp8 group quant immediately before its fp8 GEMM

strategies.description: fold the per-step MLA V-absorb weight fp8->bf16 DEQUANT into the batched GEMM
strategies.typical_seam: decode MLA V-absorb: w_vc dequant -> scale -> bmm as one prequant batched-gemm
strategies.notes: -9.13% decode kernel time, +11.80% e2e (verified). The dequant kernels must reach n=0; capture path can differ from eager.

strategies.description: MoE expert chain (GEMM1 + activation/quant + GEMM2) as one fused mega-kernel
strategies.typical_seam: expert GEMM1 -> SiLU*Mul + fp8 quant -> expert GEMM2
strategies.notes: usually ALREADY the live body kernel — mark already_engaged, not a new candidate, unless the baseline runs the split.

strategies.typical_seam: MoE gating -> biased grouped top-k -> shared-expert slot append
